description:
FR-M44-08/09/10, MVP-R1.6, MVP-R3.5 (MV1-T05): the machine-readable support matrix. One row per combination this release CLAIMS to support, each naming the smoke test that backs the claim and the date that test last passed. scripts/check-compatibility.mjs fails the build on a row whose named test does not exist, and the table in docs/DEPLOYMENT.md is generated from this file rather than maintained beside it (MV1-T06).

The rule that makes this honest: a combination NOT in this file is not claimed. Adding a row requires a passing smoke test in the same change — a row marked degraded, best-effort or supported-with-caveats is not a weaker claim, it is an unfalsifiable one (MK5).

rows.claim: The extension host, the sidecar and every git path work on Windows.
rows.evidence: CI runs the full extension and core suites on windows-latest. Windows is the platform the product was written on and the only one with platform-specific sidecar code: the orphan guard's job objects and the run lock's Win32 liveness probe.

rows.claim: The extension host and the sidecar work on a current Ubuntu LTS.
rows.evidence: CI runs the full extension, webview and core suites on ubuntu-latest on every push, and packages the VSIX there.

rows.claim: The extension host and the webview work on macOS.
rows.evidence: CI runs the extension and webview suites on macos-latest on main and on the weekly schedule. The core suite is not run there: the sidecar has no macOS-specific path and ubuntu covers POSIX.

rows.claim: The extension activates and its manifest is valid against this API level.
rows.backedBy: extension/test/manifest.test.ts > declares granular activation events and never "*" (FR-M1-01)
rows.evidence: engines.vscode is ^1.95.0 in extension/package.json and the manifest is asserted against the declared surface.

rows.claim: The sidecar starts, handshakes and serves RPCs under 3.11.
rows.evidence: core/pyproject.toml sets requires-python >= 3.11, and the real-sidecar end-to-end tests spawn the interpreter on the developer machine, where 3.11 is the version in use.

rows.claim: The sidecar starts, handshakes and serves RPCs under 3.12.
rows.evidence: CI pins python-version 3.12 for both the core suite and the real-sidecar end-to-end tests in the typescript job.

rows.value: Remote development (SSH, WSL, Dev Containers, Codespaces) — declared, not yet rehearsed
rows.claim: The extension declares extensionKind "workspace", so the sidecar runs on the remote host rather than the client.
rows.backedBy: extension/test/remote.test.ts > declares extensionKind "workspace" so the sidecar runs on the remote host
rows.evidence: The declaration is tested and no local absolute path is hard-coded. That is a necessary condition, NOT a rehearsal: no remote configuration has been exercised end to end. MV4-T02 rehearses one, and only the one it rehearses becomes a supported row.
